title: Bag of Tokens (Power and Score Trade)

monster.name: Token Gambler
monster.title: Arbitrager of Energy and Points
monster.defeatQuote: Max score achieved by buying cheap tokens and selling expensive ones!

description: You have initial `power`, initial `score = 0`, and `tokens`. Face-up: spend `tokens[i]` power to gain 1 score. Face-down: spend 1 score to gain `tokens[i]` power. Return the maximum possible score you can achieve.
starterCode:
def bagOfTokensScore(tokens: list[int], power: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def bagOfTokensScore(tokens: list[int], power: int) -> int:
    tokens.sort()
    i, j = 0, len(tokens) - 1
    score = max_score = 0
    while i <= j:
        if power >= tokens[i]:
            power -= tokens[i]
            score += 1
            i += 1
            max_score = max(max_score, score)
        elif score > 0:
            power += tokens[j]
            score -= 1
            j -= 1
        else:
            break
    return max_score
hints: Two pointers: buy cheapest token at i with power, sell most expensive token at j for power.
